name: mycrew
description: mycrew — a five-layer harness for Claude Code, each layer built on the one below. 1) mycrew-tools gives you the primitives and the house rules. 2) mycrew-pipeline is the build pipeline that carries a task from a decision to hardened code. 3) mycrew-worker is the second pilot that drives the pipeline on one project. 4) mycrew-chief owns the design and orchestrates workers across a product's sub-projects. 5) mycrew-product is the product plane on top, where you set the direction and everything below builds to it. Install mycrew-tools first.

plugins.name: mycrew-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/5 — primitives. Small, project-agnostic skills you or the model reach for while working: /slap resets a stuck fix, /likec4 draws C4 architecture-as-code, /reminder pins one rule file as a hard constraint, /retract hunts down information declared wrong and surgically removes it. Also ships the harness's rule files (rules/) to copy into a project's .claude/rules/. The primitives every layer above builds on.

plugins.name: mycrew-pipeline
plugins.description: Layer 2/5 — the build pipeline. Five stage skills that carry one task from a decision to hardened code: /how-to-do (decide a fork), /do (build it by a tight set of writing rules), then /refactor, /review, /test to harden and ship it. Skills only. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.

plugins.name: mycrew-worker
plugins.description: Layer 3/5 — the second pilot. Hand /worker any piece of work (a fix, a change, a feature, a question) and it adapts: reads the goal and design from the product plane, then drives the right mycrew-pipeline and mycrew-tools skills to finish it. It builds to the plane and never writes it — a design gap comes back as a report, not a repair. Runs inline as /worker or as a native subagent you delegate a whole task to. Built on mycrew-pipeline + mycrew-tools.

plugins.name: mycrew-chief
plugins.description: Layer 4/5 — the brain between the product plane and the repos. /chief owns the design (architecture-management for the one model.c4 tree at the product root, spec-management for the specs), decomposes an approved product feature into per-repo assignments, picks what to advance next (what-to-do), proposes new ones for the human to approve (what-to-build), and sequences and dispatches workers as native subagents (worker-orchestration). It never decides what the product should do — only the human's approval files a feature — and it never writes code. It conducts; the workers build. Built on mycrew-worker.

plugins.name: mycrew-product
plugins.description: Layer 5/5 — the product plane, and the only layer that talks to the human about direction. /product-init founds the product repository (the folder holding your sub-project repos becomes its own git repo, with a North Star drawn from you). /setup then runs an endless interview that draws the whole product out of you and files each affirmed piece where it lives: features, architecture, specs — one plane for every sub-project. Strictly extractive: your vision, never its own. Drives mycrew-chief.
